Container.Name: unraid-exporter
Container.Overview: Prometheus exporter for the Unraid API (GraphQL). Use a read-only (VIEWER) API key.

Config.Name: Unraid URL
Config.Description: Base URL of this Unraid server as reachable from the container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10 (not localhost: the container is on the bridge network).

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Read-only API key (Settings → Management Access → API Keys, role VIEWER).

Config.Name: Collectors
Config.Description: Comma-separated collectors. Remove vms/docker/ups if those features are disabled. If HDDs spin down, remove 'disks' and 'temperature': both make the API run smartctl on every disk, which wakes them (array disk temperatures stay available).

Config.Name: Network interface exclude
Config.Description: Regexp of interfaces to ignore. Docker veth names change on every container restart.

Config.Name: Timeout
Config.Description: Timeout for one scrape of the Unraid API. Keep below the Prometheus scrape_timeout.

Config.Name: Skip TLS verification
Config.Description: true to accept a self-signed certificate when UNRAID_URL is https.
